text: みずに　はいる　まえに　じゅんび　たいそう　しなきゃ！

structure.jp: みずに　はいる　まえに
じゅんび　たいそう　しなきゃ！
structure.en: I've got to do warm-up exercises!

patterns.name: 〜なければならない
patterns.explanation: しなきゃ is the short spoken form of しなければならない, which says something must be done. しなきゃ = 'I have to do it'.

patterns.name: 〜まえに
patterns.explanation: A plain verb followed by まえに says 'before doing' that thing. はいる　まえに = 'before getting in'.
